limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The parity specialization B=2Z, degreewise-split Ext computation, and ideal-approximation framework are prior art. The new claim is the arbitrary Euler-subgroup family, the zero-Euler case, the exact specialness criteria, and the boundary that the associated object cotorsion pair is complete exactly for B=Z. Similar Grothendieck-group restriction constructions under different terminology remain a residual risk. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: A sharp Euler-characteristic subgroup generalization of the parity cotorsion obstruction for bounded complexes, with exact criteria for object special approximations and a complete classification of when completeness descends.
record_title: Euler-subgroup obstructions to object cotorsion completeness
